answers.goals: Keep the system supportable and changeable: supported runtimes, a test safety net, and a build any developer can run.
answers.targetStack: Latest long-term-support release of the current stack
answers.rewriteAppetite: upgrade in place where possible, rewrite only what blocks it
answers.mustNotChange: Observable behaviour, public APIs and stored data; the dossier assumes all three are contracts
answers.modulesOfInterest: no preference; the dossier proposes by dependency order and risk
answers.interfacesToKeep: none beyond those in 'must not change'
